services.name: Historic exterior repaints
services.blurb: Single houses and Victorians on the peninsula, prepped by hand and painted in colors that suit the street.

services.name: Haint blue porch ceilings
services.blurb: Piazza ceilings washed of mildew, primed and painted the soft blue Charleston porches are known for.

services.name: Shutters and doors
services.blurb: Louvered shutters and front doors stripped, primed and finished in deep, glossy coats.

services.name: Coastal exterior painting
services.blurb: Island and marsh-side homes painted with salt and sun in mind, and timed around the humid months.

services.name: Wood and trim repair
services.blurb: Salt-softened sills, rails and balusters repaired or remade before any primer goes on.

services.name: Interior painting
services.blurb: Plaster walls, tall ceilings and old trim painted with careful prep and crisp lines.

services.name: Pressure washing
services.blurb: Low-pressure washing that lifts mildew and salt from siding and porches without gouging the wood.

services.name: Iron gate and railing painting
services.blurb: Rust brushed off, metal primer applied and gates and railings painted near-black again.

services.name: Color matching for historic homes
services.blurb: Old paint layers sampled and matched, so the new coat looks right next to the neighbors.

proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Our single house on Tradd Street hadn't been painted in eleven years. Wendell's crew replaced six rotten balusters, hand-scraped the piazza and matched the old yellow from a chip they took under the eaves. It looks like the house in the 1950s photo we have.
reviews.name: Eleanor G.

reviews.text: The porch ceiling had black mildew spots every summer. They washed it, used a mildew-resistant primer and repainted it pale blue. Two summers now and it is still clean.
reviews.name: Marcus J.

reviews.text: We live on the marsh on James Island and the paint used to chalk off within three years. They explained why they wanted to start early in the morning and stop when the dew came back. So far so good.
reviews.name: Lydia S.

reviews.text: They took all twelve shutters off, stripped them in their shop and brought them back a deep glossy black. Every louver is clean and none of the hinges were painted shut.
reviews.name: Henry W.

reviews.text: Our front gate was more rust than iron. They wire-brushed it on site, primed it before the afternoon storms and painted it black the next morning.
reviews.name: Rosa C.

reviews.text: High plaster ceilings in our living room and a lot of cracks. They patched each one, let it dry overnight and cut the lines along the crown molding by hand. Not a drip on the heart pine floors.
reviews.name: Calvin B.

proof.guarantee: If exterior paint we applied peels within two years, we return and repair that area.
